proposal.summary: cuobjdump in the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit SDK has a bug where running the tool against an ill-formed binary may cause a null-pointer dereference, potentially causing a limited denial of service.

AV.quote: a local user running the tool

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the exact cuobjdump version and reproduce the null-pointer dereference with an ill-formed binary, capture crash details (stack trace, logs), and report to the vendor with reproduction steps and sample file.

evidence_quotes.quote: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit SDK contains a bug in cuobjdump
a local user running the tool against an ill-formed binary
may cause a null- pointer dereference, which may result in a limited denial of service.
